How cousins work

    Say the Greek word aloud, swap the letters, then listen for an English word. χρόνος → chronos → chronology.

    Cousins are memory hooks, not translations. Some meanings drifted: σπίτι (house) is related to hospital, and ίδιος (same, own) is related to idiom.
